objective: Qualify the R38 FreeNetHub Direct Method from the actual installed payload while preserving the accepted R37 rollback baseline and clean Windows network state.

failureRootCause.symptom: Two early installer executions returned exit code 1.
failureRootCause.rootCause: The first EXE was an incomplete artifact produced while the original synchronous ISCC command was terminated by the 15-second command timeout; file existence was incorrectly insufficient as a completion signal.
failureRootCause.evidence: Incomplete EXE was 15410692 bytes; completed detached build EXE is 24245986 bytes and has a PASS build record.
failureRootCause.prevention: Never promote or execute an installer solely because the output path exists. Require builder completion evidence, frozen-source verification, final size/hash, then execute only the hash-pinned completed artifact.

conclusion: Installed R38 Direct Method behavior and rollback are accepted. A metadata-only final packaging pass may follow without repeating the already hash-stable network lifecycle code.
